summary: Service implementation for the 9 dataset file-curation subcommands (sort-and-rename, strip-metadata, normalize, create-captions, archive-poor-candidates, detect-borders, detect-faces, crop-borders, process): Context.Service contract + live layer + accessor facade, plus ~5,000 LOC of private validation, directory-scan, media-probe (sharp/ffprobe/ffmpeg/face-detection), plan-build, plan-apply, manifest-render, and a standalone file-processing-proof subsystem all in one file.

concerns.name: Service contract, tag, live layer, accessor facade
concerns.description: FilesCommandServiceShape interface, Context.Service tag keyed by $RepoCliId, makeFilesCommandService capturing runtime context, FilesCommandServiceLive, and 9 exported Effect.fn accessor use-cases plus printFilesIndex.

concerns.name: Options and directory validation
concerns.description: Schema-decode wrappers over Files.schemas decode* fns plus filesystem-aware directory validation (stat/realPath/canonical-equality, refuse source==target). Lines 435-1000.

concerns.name: Overwrite/collision preflight guards
concerns.description: Pre-apply safety checks: refuse overwriting existing files without --overwrite, duplicate target detection, rename-set collision checks. Lines 2583-2676 and 3281-3310.

concerns.name: Directory scan / candidate collection with per-command skip taxonomy
concerns.description: Five near-identical collect pipelines (sortable, normalize, detect-borders, detect-faces, archive-candidate) that walk a directory, reject symlinks/dirs/extensionless/video, and build SortableFile + typed skipped entries via make*SkippedEntry constructors. Lines 638-748, 1002-1236, 1546-1920.

concerns.name: External media tool exec and probing (sharp / ffprobe / image-size)
concerns.description: Trusted-binary resolution (BEEP_FFMPEG_PATH/BEEP_FFPROBE_PATH, TrustedMediaToolRoots allowlist), ChildProcess ffprobe runs, EXIF/rotation-aware dimension probing, raw pixel decode via sharp. Lines 291-332, 1922-2095.

concerns.name: Border and face analysis
concerns.description: Pure-ish per-file analysis producing DetectBordersEntry / DetectFacesEntry: solid-border classification over raw pixels and face flagging (area pct, edge margin, multiple-faces) via @beep/face-detection detector. Lines 2097-2210.

concerns.name: Plan builders
concerns.description: Dry-run-able plan construction for each command: unique target-name allocation, dimension probing, candidate assessment, sidecar collection. Lines 1238-1488, 2212-2581, 3230-3279, 3474-3524.

concerns.name: Plan application (staged temp-dir FS transactions)
concerns.description: Mutating apply phases using acquireUseRelease temp dirs, sharp rewrites (normalize/strip/crop to temp), ffmpeg metadata strip, two-phase renames, no-face moves. Lines 1490-1544, 2678-2698, 2935-3228, 3318-3472, 3526-3739.

concerns.name: Dedupe hashing and byte comparison
concerns.description: Hand-rolled crypto.subtle SHA-256 hex hashing plus byte-equality dedupe for normalize outputs; duplicates the Sha256HexFromBytes schema used by the process subsystem in the same file. Lines 2700-2773.

concerns.name: Manifest/report construction, JSON rendering, console logging
concerns.description: Schema-encoded manifests rendered through renderBiomeJson, detect-faces manifest write, and eight Console.log plan/report loggers delegating to Files.media render* formatters. Lines 2801-2933, 3312-3316, 3741-3805, 4719-4732.

concerns.name: File-processing proof subsystem (process subcommand)
concerns.description: Self-contained pipeline over @beep/file-processing engines (tika/libpff/test): recursive input collection, digest/artifact/operation-id minting, engine selection, outcome records, coverage summary, and run/coverage/sources/failures manifest tree writer. Lines 217-252, 3807-4706 — only shares FilesCommandError and FilesConcurrency with the rest.

concerns.name: Command orchestrator impls
concerns.description: Nine *Impl Effect.fn generators (lines 4665-5439) wiring validate -> plan -> log -> dry-run branch -> preflight -> apply -> summary, each wrapped in profilePhase with per-command telemetry attributes and Console/Effect.logInfo output.

proposedSplit.contents: Keep only FilesCommandServiceShape, FilesCommandService tag (preserving the $RepoCliId identity string), FilesCommandServiceRequirements, makeFilesCommandService, FilesCommandServiceLive, the 9 exported accessor use-cases, and the 9 *Impl orchestrators (which are the service method bodies). Shrinks to ~1,400 LOC.

buildRenamePlan, buildStripMetadataPlan, buildNormalizePlan, buildCreateCaptionFilesPlan, buildCropBordersPlan, buildArchivePoorCandidatesPlan, collectArchiveSidecars, uniqueNormalizeTargetName, uniqueArchiveTargetName, cropBordersDetectionOptions, makeNormalizeManifestOptions, makeDetectFacesReportOptions.

Manifest/report constructors and Biome-JSON renderers (makeNormalizeManifest, renderNormalizeManifest, makeArchivePoorCandidatesManifest, renderArchivePoorCandidatesManifest, renderDetectBordersReportJson, renderDetectFacesReportJson, writeDetectFacesManifest, archivedEntries, countMovedSidecars) plus the eight log* Console helpers and printFilesIndex.

validatePrefix, validateDirectory, validateNormalizeMaxLongEdge, validate*Options (create-captions/detect-borders/detect-faces/crop-borders/archive), validateDetectFacesMoveNoFaceDirectory, validateNormalizeDuplicateDirectory, validateNormalizeDirectories, validateArchiveDirectories, parseSidecarExtensions, and the preflight* overwrite/collision guards.

The five collect pipelines (collectSortableFile/s, collectNormalizeFile/s, collectDetectBordersFile/s, collectDetectFacesFiles, collectArchiveCandidateFile/s), the make*SkippedEntry constructors, detectFacesSkippedFromBorders, and the *CollectedEntries / SortableCollectedEntry local interfaces.

All external-tool and sharp I/O: resolveTrustedMediaToolPath, FfmpegLocalProtocolWhitelist, TrustedMediaToolRoots, UnsafeMetadataVideoExtensions, isUnsafeMetadataVideoExtension, runFfprobe, probeImage/Video/MediaDimensions, readImagePixelsForBorderDetection, normalizeImageToTemp, stripImageMetadataToTemp, cropImageBordersToTemp, runFfmpegStripMetadata, stripVideoMetadataToTemp, stripMetadataToTemp.
Per-file analysis producing report entries: analyzeDetectBordersFile, analyzeDetectFacesFile, detectFacesFlags, faceAreaPct, faceAtEdge (depends on MediaExec pixel reads and @beep/face-detection).

Staged temp-dir apply transactions: applyCreateCaptionFilesPlan, applyNormalizePlan, applyArchivePoorCandidatesPlan, applyRenamePlan, applyStripMetadataPlan, applyCropBordersPlan, renameOrFail, moveDetectFacesNoFaceEntries, withDetectFacesMovedNoFaceTarget, dedupe helpers (bytesEqual, hashFileSha256, fileBytesEqual, findDuplicateOutput, withOutputMetadata), and NormalizeSeenOutput/NormalizeDuplicateMove/NormalizeApplyResult interfaces.

The entire file-processing proof subsystem (lines 217-252 interfaces plus 3807-4706): process* constants and decoders, digest/artifact/operation-id makers, collectProcessDirectoryFiles/collectProcessInputFiles, canonicalizeProcessTargetPath, prepareProcessOutDir, prepareProcessSource, record/outcome constructors, engine selection, processPreparedSource, makeProcessCoverage, encodeProcessJsonLine, writeProcessStringFile, writeProcessManifestTree, and processFilesImpl. Lowest-coupling seam in the file.

sharedCandidates.description: Generic resolve+stat+realPath directory validation returning {canonicalDir, directory} with a typed error; every --dir-taking command reimplements some form of this. Needs error-type parameterization to leave the group.
Refuse-to-overwrite-unless-flag guard (exists + not-file checks with typed error); a generic output-safety primitive for any command writing artifacts.

Generic file hashing and byte-equality; hashFileSha256 hand-rolls crypto.subtle while processHashBytes in the same file already uses @beep/schema Sha256HexFromBytes — consolidate on the schema and promote the file-level wrapper.
Trusted ffmpeg/ffprobe binary resolution with env override and allowlisted roots; belongs beside the @beep/ffmpeg driver the Image group already uses rather than inside a CLI command group.
Rename with typed error and recovery-temp-dir hint; trivial but reusable staged-rename primitive for any temp-dir transaction pattern.
Schema-encode a value to a newline-terminated JSONL line with a labeled typed error; generic for any command emitting JSONL manifests.
Collision-suffixing target-name allocator over a HashSet; the two are near-duplicates and could be one shared name-allocation helper for any move/emit command.

risks: index.ts does `export * from './Files.service.js'` — the public facade (FilesCommandService, FilesCommandServiceLive, printFilesIndex, 9 accessors) must survive the split exactly; adding Files.plan.ts/Files.render.ts to index.ts would EXPAND the public API (architecture says deep role files are private), so either keep new role files out of index.ts or curate named re-exports; internal/ modules must not be exported at all.

test/files-command.test.ts and dtslint/Files.tst.ts import from '@beep/repo-cli/commands/Files' (processFiles, FilesCommandServiceLive, accessor fns, FilesCommandService type); dtslint asserts exact Effect success/error/env types, so any accidental widening of an impl's R channel (e.g., detectFacesFilesImpl's explicit requirement union) breaks tstyche and Layer.effect typing.

The Context.Service identity is $RepoCliId.create('commands/Files/Files.service') + $I`FilesCommandService` — the tag must stay in Files.service.ts (or keep an identical identity string) or service resolution/telemetry naming changes; similarly Effect.fn trace labels ('Files.*', 'FilesCommandService.*') and profilePhase phase names are observability contracts to preserve verbatim.

makeFilesCommandService captures Effect.context<FilesCommandServiceRequirements>() once and provides it into every impl — moved impls/helpers must keep requirements within FileSystem|Path|Terminal|ChildProcessSpawner|Crypto or the layer stops compiling; the Config read in resolveTrustedMediaToolPath deliberately uses orElseSucceed so no Config service is required — do not 'clean up' that fallback.

Ordering/state hazards: buildCreateCaptionFilesPlan and applyNormalizePlan mutate `let` accumulators (HashSet/A.append) inside Effect.fnUntraced callbacks guarded only by concurrency: 1 — any split that changes concurrency options or reorders the plan->manifest->move phases (manifest is rendered mid-transaction inside applyNormalizePlan's temp dir) breaks dedupe and atomicity.

Docgen/lint gates: every export in new role files needs @example/@category/@since JSDoc with imports from '@beep/repo-cli/commands/Files' that must actually resolve; run bun run docgen:local and yeet verify after the split, and watch the known turbo build/check cache race when checking cross-package.

summary: Schema-only role file for the Files command group: LiteralKit domains, filtered primitives, S.Class plan/manifest/report/summary models, and decode/encode codec constants for nine dataset-curation subcommands (sort-and-rename, strip-metadata, create-captions, normalize, archive-poor-candidates, detect-borders, crop-borders, detect-faces, process). It is role-pure (no service logic, rendering, or process exec) but is nine subcommands' worth of schemas in one 2486-line file.

concerns.name: Shared media primitive schemas
concerns.description: Cross-subcommand filtered primitives: positive dimensions, pixel offsets, media kind, 8-bit RGB channel, safe filename prefix, sha256-prefixed hash, MediaDimensions class. Used by nearly every other cluster in the file.

concerns.name: External-tool probe output models
concerns.description: Schemas modeling third-party tool JSON (image-size package, ffprobe) plus their decoders. This is boundary-decoding of external process output, not command option/plan data.

concerns.name: sort-and-rename schemas
concerns.description: Rename planning models including the S.suspend forward reference to MediaDimensions in RenamePlanEntry.

concerns.name: strip-metadata schemas
concerns.description: Metadata-strip plan and summary plus the sharp-supported image extension domain.

concerns.name: create-captions schemas
concerns.description: Caption sidecar options, plan, skipped-entry, summary models and skipped-reason domain plus decoder.

concerns.name: normalize schemas
concerns.description: Image normalization option/plan/manifest/summary models, format literal domains, and its codec constants including the versioned NormalizeManifest.

concerns.name: archive-poor-candidates schemas
concerns.description: Candidate-quality triage domains (profile/decision/reason), ratio threshold primitive, assessment metrics, sidecar/entry/plan/manifest/summary models plus codecs.

concerns.name: border detection + cropping schemas
concerns.description: Shared border-scan threshold primitives, side/kind domains, RgbColor, side measurements, detect-borders report models and crop-borders plan models plus codecs. detect and crop intentionally share DetectBorderSideMeasurement and the threshold schemas.

concerns.name: detect-faces schemas
concerns.description: Face detection option/entry/report models built on @beep/face-detection schemas, triage flag domain, plus codecs.

concerns.name: files process schemas
concerns.description: Options and summary for the file-processing engine subcommand, referencing @beep/file-processing FileProcessingEngineFamily.

proposedSplit.contents: Shrinks to a curated barrel re-exporting the internal schema modules below (~80 LOC). Preserves the two large './Files.schemas.js' import blocks in Files.service.ts (lines 174/206), Files.command.ts, Files.media.ts, and the index.ts facade untouched.

Shared primitives (PositiveMediaDimension, NonNegativePixelOffset, MediaKind, RgbChannel, MediaDimensions, SafeFilePrefix, FileSha256Hash) plus probe models (ImageSizeMetadata, Ffprobe*) and decodeImageSizeMetadata/decodeFfprobeOutputJson/decodeRotationNumber. Leaf module all other internal schema files import; must import none of them back.
SortableFile, RenamePlanEntry (S.suspend on MediaDimensions can become a direct import), SortAndRenameSummary, SortableFileCollection, RenamePlan, decodeSafeFilePrefix.
SupportedMetadataImageExtension, StripMetadataPlanEntry, StripMetadataSummary, StripMetadataPlan.
CreateCaptionFilesSkippedReason, CreateCaptionFilesOptions/PlanEntry/SkippedEntry/Plan/Summary, decodeCreateCaptionFilesOptions.

NormalizeImageFormatInput/NormalizeImageFormat/NormalizeSkippedReason, NormalizeFilesOptions, NormalizeManifestOptions, NormalizePlanEntry, NormalizeSkippedEntry, NormalizePlan, NormalizeSummary, NormalizeManifestSummary, NormalizeManifest, decodeNormalizeMaxLongEdge, encodeNormalizeManifest.

CandidateAssessment* domains, CandidateRatioThreshold, ArchivePoorCandidates* option/entry/plan/manifest/summary classes, ArchivedSidecarEntry, decodeArchivePoorCandidatesOptions, encodeArchivePoorCandidatesManifest.

One module for both detect-borders and crop-borders (they share BorderDetection* thresholds and DetectBorderSideMeasurement): BorderSide, BorderDetectionKind, RgbColor, DetectBorders* entry/report/summary, CropBorders* options/plan/summary, decodeDetectBordersOptions, decodeCropBordersOptions, encodeDetectBordersReport.
DetectFacesSkippedReason, DetectFacesFlag, DetectFacesOptions, DetectFacesReportOptions, DetectFacesEntry/SkippedEntry/Summary/Report, decodeDetectFacesOptions, encodeDetectFacesReport.
ProcessFilesFailurePolicy, ProcessFilesOptions, ProcessFilesSummary.

sharedCandidates.description: Regex-checked 'sha256:<64 hex>' string. Duplicates the concept of Sha256Hex in @beep/schema (packages/foundation/modeling/schema/src/Sha256.ts); Corpus.service.ts manually synthesizes 'sha256:' || sha256 digests in SQL. A prefixed-digest transformation belongs beside Sha256Hex in @beep/schema.
Generic positive pixel width/height primitives with no Files-specific semantics; the crispening inventory (S5) already proposes reusing PositiveMediaDimension for other raw-image shapes.
Plain 8-bit channel and RGB triple schemas, nothing border-specific.
Boundary models for third-party probe tools (image-size, ffprobe); any media-touching command needs identical shapes. Candidate for @beep/file-processing or a shared media-probe module.
Generic safe filename-stem schema (no dot/separator/NUL); useful anywhere the CLI generates output filenames.
image|video discriminator LiteralKit with no Files-specific coupling.

risks: $I identity path is baked into every schema identifier via $RepoCliId.create("commands/Files/Files.schemas"); split files get new module paths, changing annotation identifiers, so tracked standards/schema-catalog.generated.jsonc and standards/jsdoc-documentation.inventory.* must be regenerated (deterministic, but a required proof step).

Public facade breadth: index.ts does export * from './Files.schemas.js' and dtslint/Files.tst.ts + test/files-command.test.ts import ~40 of these symbols via @beep/repo-cli/commands/Files — the barrel must re-export every current export (values AND types) or dtslint/tstyche and vitest break.

Files.service.ts (5680 LOC) imports schemas in two separate blocks (lines 174 and 206) from './Files.schemas.js'; keeping Files.schemas.ts as the barrel avoids touching the service, media, and command files at all.

RenamePlanEntry uses S.suspend(() => MediaDimensions) as a same-file forward reference; after the split the dependency must stay one-way (SortAndRename → Media) or the suspend must be preserved, otherwise a module cycle/TDZ at load time.

detect-borders and crop-borders schemas share DetectBorderSideMeasurement and the BorderDetection* thresholds — splitting them into two files creates cross-imports; keep them in a single Borders.schemas.ts.

goals/repo-crispening-orchestration/ops/inventory/S2-S5 findings reference Files.schemas.ts line numbers (e.g. :976, :745-771); those pointers go stale after the split and any in-flight crispening work should be reconciled first.

summary: Grab-bag "media helpers" module for the Files dataset-curation command group: it mixes local schema classes, a raw-pixel border-detection engine, extension/media-kind guards, orientation/dimension math, candidate-quality assessment, plan-entry construction, and 13 plain-text renderers, all consumed by the 5680-line Files.service.ts and re-exported wholesale through commands/Files/index.ts.

concerns.name: Local schema class definitions
concerns.description: Seven S.Class schemas defined in a .media file instead of Files.schemas.ts (lines 55-133). TargetNameForEntryOptions, StripMetadataTempEntry, RawImagePixelData, BorderDetectionThresholds, BorderLineStats, CandidateAssessmentThresholds, CandidateAssessmentResult.

concerns.name: Border-detection pixel-scan engine (private)
concerns.description: Imperative raw-pixel scanning machinery, all module-private (lines 134-269): per-side axis geometry, median edge-color sampling, per-line solidity stats, and the side-scan loop producing DetectBorderSideMeasurement.

concerns.name: Border-detection public API + classification
concerns.description: Exported entry points over the scan engine: analyzeSolidBorders (dual), classifyBorderSides (frame/pillarbox/letterbox/canvas-edge/mixed), rgbToHex, and scanBorderSide which bridges private stats to the public measurement schema.

concerns.name: Extension guards and file orderings
concerns.description: Schema-derived S.is guards for image/video/metadata-strippable extensions, media-kind resolution, and Order combinators for SortableFile.

concerns.name: Orientation and dimension math
concerns.description: Pure media geometry: EXIF/ffprobe rotation interpretation, dimension swapping, long-edge downscale computation, dimension diffing, and sharp/normalize format mapping.

concerns.name: Candidate-quality assessment
concerns.description: assessImageCandidate applies hard thresholds (short edge, aspect, upscale factor) to decide keep/archive with metrics. Note roundCandidateMetric (line 773) duplicates private roundMetric (line 138) verbatim.

concerns.name: Plan-entry construction
concerns.description: Builders that turn probed files/detections into plan entries: generated target filenames, temp-path staging for metadata stripping, selected-path hash sets, and detection-to-crop-plan conversion.

concerns.name: Plain-text rendering
concerns.description: Thirteen render* functions producing human-readable plan/report/skipped lines, one per subcommand output shape. Pure string formatting over schema types — the canonical <Group>.render.ts role.

concerns.name: Generic child-process stream collection
concerns.description: collectText decodes a Uint8Array stream to trimmed text — nothing media- or Files-specific; the identical helper is copy-pasted in at least 5 other command-group files.

proposedSplit.contents: All 13 render* line formatters (renderPlanEntry through renderCropBordersPlanEntry, including skipped-entry variants). Depends only on Files.schemas types; zero coupling to the pixel engine or plan builders.

Plan construction and decisions: targetNameForEntry (+TargetNameForEntryOptions), formatIndex, hasSkippedFiles, selectedCanonicalPathSet, makeStripMetadataTempEntries (+StripMetadataTempEntry), cropBordersPlanEntryFromDetection (+borderWidthForSide), assessImageCandidate, roundCandidateMetric (consolidated with private roundMetric).

Slimmed to genuine media substance: extension guards, mediaKindFromExtension, normalizeBareExtension, SortableFile orderings, EXIF/rotation helpers, maybeSwapDimensions, rotationFromStream, normalizeOutputDimensions/Extension, sharpFormatForNormalize, mediaDimensionsChanged, plus the public border API (analyzeSolidBorders, classifyBorderSides, rgbToHex) delegating to internal/BorderDetection.

Private pixel-scan machinery: BorderLineStats, borderSides, byteAt, pixelOffset, medianChannel, sampleAxisLength/scanLineLength, borderX/borderY, sampleBorderColor, borderLineStats, scanBorderSide, channelToHex. Mirrors the existing internal/ convention in Quality, Docgen, Research, Yeet groups; not re-exported by index.ts.

Move the public-signature schema classes here: RawImagePixelData and BorderDetectionThresholds (appear in analyzeSolidBorders' signature), CandidateAssessmentThresholds and CandidateAssessmentResult (assessImageCandidate signature). File is already 2486 LOC, so keep this a schemas-role move only, not a dumping ground.
Promote collectText here (package-level internal, alongside existing Printer.ts/Flags.ts) and retire the five duplicate definitions in Quality and Docgen internals.

sharedCandidates.description: Uint8Array stream -> decoded trimmed string; used for child-process stdout/stderr collection. Verbatim duplicates already exist at Quality/internal/QualityArtifactSupport.ts:749 (exported), Quality/FallowQuality.command.ts:759, Quality/internal/TurboConfigProof.ts:405, Quality/internal/PackageVerify.ts:202, and Docgen/internal/Local.ts:381.
Dual-arity zero-padded index formatter. Corpus.service.ts:2564, Lint/SchemaFirst.ts:524, and Laws/DualArity.ts:267 hand-roll the same padStart pattern.

S.is guards over @beep/schema ImageFileExtension/VideoFileExtension plus extension normalization — not Files-specific; any media-touching group can use them. The Image group currently does raw path.extname handling (Image.service.ts:177).
Generic RgbColor -> #rrggbb formatter (RgbColor itself lives in Files.schemas.ts); would serve any image-analysis command.

risks: commands/Files/index.ts uses export * per role file; every new file (Files.render.ts, Files.plan.ts) must be added to the facade or dtslint/Files.tst.ts and test/files-command.test.ts imports via @beep/repo-cli/commands/Files silently lose symbols (package.json maps ./commands/Files to that index).

Files.service.ts (5680 LOC) imports 37 named symbols from ./Files.media.js in one block (lines 78-116); the split must rewrite that import into 3-4 blocks and any miss surfaces only at check time — beware the known turbo build/check cache race producing phantom 'no exported member' failures after the move.

Moving S.Class declarations changes their $I identity prefix from commands/Files/Files.media to the new module path; if any manifest/snapshot or annotation-dependent tooling encodes those schema identifiers, output diffs (schema-catalog is generated and tracked per commit 5783560).

Every exported symbol carries docgen-checked JSDoc (@example importing from @beep/repo-cli/commands/Files, @category, @since); new files need packageDocumentation headers and complete annotations or bun run docgen fails.

Consolidating duplicate roundMetric/roundCandidateMetric and promoting collectText touches Quality and Docgen internals — keep behavior identical (trim + concat fold) since Quality variants differ slightly in type parameters (<E,R> vs <E>).

Avoid import cycles: internal/BorderDetection.ts must depend only on Files.schemas.ts, and Files.plan.ts's cropBordersPlanEntryFromDetection needs DetectBordersEntry from schemas, not from Files.media.ts.
